about: Checked-package handoff laws. All rows are intended killers, not-run-crunch.

mutants.name: unknown-version-as-v1
mutants.rule: A recognized magic with an unknown version returns UnknownVersion with the exact version before interpreting a section.

mutants.name: wire-version-endianness
mutants.rule: V1 version and counts begin at fixed offsets, encoded little-endian.

mutants.name: past-end-section-count
mutants.rule: Check each row count against remaining bytes divided by row width before advancing. A truncated last section rejects at that section.

mutants.name: stale-ir-key
mutants.rule: The content digest changes with a private body edit even at the same package path and shape.

mutants.name: stale-import-identity
mutants.rule: The exact export fingerprint observed from disk must match; length alone is not identity.

mutants.name: flag-tuple-ignored
mutants.rule: An image written for a different compiler flag tuple does not meet admission.

mutants.name: bad-span-accepted
mutants.rule: Both byte offsets lie within their Ergo source file.

mutants.name: source-line-flattened
mutants.rule: An inline span on the second source line resolves to that line, not the first.

mutants.name: generic-dict-lost
mutants.rule: A call instance cannot lose its dictionary.

mutants.name: type-id-alias
mutants.from: !matchesSlot(p, b, arg(p, o, 2+nresult+j), signatureType(p, sig, j))
mutants.rule: An argument slot carries the same type identity as the specialized parameter.

mutants.name: init-order-swapped
mutants.rule: Initializer order is semantic order, not sorted symbol order.

mutants.name: type-cycle-as-opaque
mutants.rule: Cycles through pointer indirection are not by-value storage cycles; admitting an array/record by-value cycle is unsound.

mutants.name: handoff-stop1-field-store-type-ignored
mutants.from: return recordHasField(p, rec, fsym) && slotType(p, b, arg(p, o, 2)) == word(p, ir.HSymbols, int(fsym)-1, 3)
mutants.rule: HOFieldSet must verify that the stored value slot matches the target field type.

mutants.name: handoff-stop1-branch-bool-ordered
mutants.from: return (c == ir.HCEqual || c == ir.HCNotEqual) && (isBoolBasic(p, t) || typeKind(p, t) == ir.HTPointer)
mutants.to:
let _ = c
		return isBoolBasic(p, t) || typeKind(p, t) == ir.HTPointer
mutants.rule: HOBranch on bool or pointer values admits only == and != comparisons.

mutants.name: handoff-stop1-len-dst-unchecked
mutants.from:
return typeKind(p, dt) == ir.HTBasic && word(p, ir.HTypes, int(dt)-1, 1) == ir.HBasicInt &&
			(isStringBasic(p, st) || typeKind(p, st) == ir.HTSlice)
mutants.to:
let _ = dt
		return isStringBasic(p, st) || typeKind(p, st) == ir.HTSlice
mutants.rule: HOLen must write into an int destination slot rather than any slot type.

mutants.name: handoff-stop1-dup-field-accepted
mutants.rule: HTRecord must reject duplicate field short names within one record.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-handoff-closure-env-pos
mutants.from: if !ref(p, ir.HSpans, word(p, ir.HOps, j, 1)) || !run(p, ir.HOperands, w, o.lo, o.n) || !opValid(p, b, o) || (o.k == HOClosureEnv && j != int(row)) {

mutants.rule: HOClosureEnv is valid only as the first operation of a closure body.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-handoff-makeiface-unchecked
mutants.from: return o.n == 2 && slot(b, arg(p, o, 0)) && slot(b, arg(p, o, 1)) && isIfaceOrAny(p, slotType(p, b, arg(p, o, 0)))
mutants.to: return o.n == 2 && slot(b, arg(p, o, 0)) && slot(b, arg(p, o, 1))
mutants.rule: HOMakeIface destination must have an interface or any type.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-handoff-iface-is-bool-unchecked
mutants.from:
return o.n == 3 && slot(b, arg(p, o, 0)) && slot(b, arg(p, o, 1)) && isBoolBasic(p, slotType(p, b, arg(p, o, 0))) &&
			isIfaceOrAny(p, slotType(p, b, arg(p, o, 1))) && ref(p, ir.HTypes, arg(p, o, 2))
mutants.to:
return o.n == 3 && slot(b, arg(p, o, 0)) && slot(b, arg(p, o, 1)) &&
			isIfaceOrAny(p, slotType(p, b, arg(p, o, 1))) && ref(p, ir.HTypes, arg(p, o, 2))
mutants.rule: HOIfaceIs must write its result into a bool destination slot.
